name: Comedy Blaps
description: Comedy Blaps is Channel 4's vehicle for piloting comedy online. Some pilots consist of a single short, whereas others consist of a few shorts.

videos.title: What is England?
videos.overview: One of Australia's most serious and busiest actors (also millennial illusionist), Claudia O'Doherty has come to the UK to make some viral videos for her family's travel agency. This episode, England is a lot of things, isn't it? Royalty, winter, apple pie. Scotland! Solitude. Get the real scoop on England from Australia's most serious actor, Claudia O'Doherty.

videos.title: What is Jack the Ripper?
videos.overview: One of Australia's most serious and busiest actors (also millennial illusionist), Claudia O'Doherty has come to the UK to make some viral videos for her family's travel agency. The thing with Jack the Ripper is: he's a killer, but everyone in England loves him, but is also scared of him, and they still don't know who he is. So Claudia O'Doherty has decided to do something the English could never be bothered to do, and solve the mystery of Jack the Ripper once and for all.

videos.title: What is Time?
videos.overview: One of Australia's most serious and busiest actors (also millennial illusionist), Claudia O'Doherty has come to the UK to make some viral videos for her family's travel agency. Time was invented in England so if you're going to travel there on holiday, it's important to know what time is. In this video, Claudia O'Doherty, Australia's most serious actor and millennial illusionist, attempts to unravel the mysteries of time.

videos.title: ACMS Presents: A Board Meeting - Episode 1: The Ground Floor is on Fire
videos.overview: A fast-paced, lunatic comedy from the people behind the hit live show 'The Alternative Comedy Memorial Society'. The familiar structure of a board-meeting, from apologies to any-other-business, is used to sneak the unfamiliar, nonsensical and downright bizarre onto people's screens -- guerrilla-style and in a mixture of live action and animation. All four episodes are a different meeting, derailed by flashbacks and cutaways, and Cistercian monks, Norse Goddesses, Jeff Goldblum lookalikes and instructional videos about knots. A sort of Mad Hatter's Tea Party in an oak-panelled room.

Even if that means pitching to Simon Swervy, a man with all the power and self-awareness of a diseased and insane Roman Emperor.

videos.title: Lives of the Infamous: Part 1 of 3
videos.overview:
LIVES OF THE INFAMOUS documents the glorious highs and horrific lows of the notorious Wanger Twins - East End brothers, who ruled the London club scene throughout the 1950s, before being betrayed in a police sting, then rising again with an unlikely pop hit, Wet Spanish Legs. With Jim Broadbent.

The first part of LIVES OF THE INFAMOUS tells the extraordinary life story of Adam and Dunhill Wanger, who ruled London’s murky underworld in the Swinging 60s, before being brought to their knees by an ingenious Scotland Yard sting during the Miss London pageant of 1965.  Told through archive footage and interviews with those who knew them best, this is the definitive tale of the infamous Wanger Twins.

videos.title: Lives of the Infamous: Part 2 of 3
videos.overview: Part 2 of LIVES OF THE INFAMOUS reveals the remarkable change in fortunes of the Wanger Twins, Adam and Dunhill.  We witness the decline of their nightclub empire and the unexpected new-found fame with a novelty pop single.  The song, Wet Spanish Legs, proved a huge hit in Greece, but it also led to their final, ignominious downfall, live on television, with the death of celebrated Greek chatshow host, Terrios Espass.

videos.title: Lives of the Infamous: Part 3 of 3
videos.overview: The final part of LIVES OF THE INFAMOUS shows, for the very first time, the full-length version of the novelty pop classic, Wet Spanish Legs, by Adam and Dunhill Wanger, shortly before their appearance on Greek Chat show, Espass, and the subsequent death of its celebrated host, Terrios Espass.
